responsibility: This file expands statement-level tree constructs into RTL control-flow and asm-related sequences. It owns LABEL_DECL to CODE_LABEL mapping, goto and label emission, switch/case lowering decisions including dispatch tables and decrement chains, and parsing/support for extended asm operand constraints and named operands, producing the branch structure and statement-oriented RTL scaffolding that sits above expression expansion.
same_name_distinction: Implements the stmt stem’s statement-expansion behavior declared in gcc/stmt.h, including LABEL_DECL-to-RTL creation, goto/label emission, switch lowering, and extended-asm constraint parsing. Unlike the header, this file contains the actual control-flow and asm-lowering code rather than only API declarations.
